note: On the north end of Lake Diefenbaker near Gardiner Dam, 100 km S of Saskatoon. The three loops (Elmview, Bayside, Shady Lane) sit in planted shelterbelts on the east side of Coteau Bay; a narrow arm of the bay lies 100 m south of the nearest sites. About a third of the sites are seasonal. --Claude
